title: 新加坡新生水系統
summary: 以新生水為觀察案例，學徒扮演水質工程師，沿進水、膜列、消毒、儲水與需求端追蹤水和污染物。
summaryEn: Using NEWater as the reference, the learner acts as a water-quality engineer following water and contaminants through feed, membrane trains, disinfection, storage and demand.
scope: 公開原理與資料支持的原創教學。算例中的輸入為明示教學假設，非該設施實測或操作設定。此處任務在離線模型完成，不能作為現場設計、飲用水合格或設備操作許可。
scopeEn: Original teaching based on public principles and sources. Numerical inputs are explicit teaching assumptions, not site measurements or operating setpoints. Tasks use offline models and do not certify field design, potable-water compliance or equipment operation.

steps.title: 閉合回用水流程
steps.titleEn: Close the reclaimed-water loop
steps.objective: 區分已處理用水、再生水與最終使用。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish treated used water, reclaimed product and final use.
steps.instruction: 畫出已處理用水→MF/UF→RO→UV的概念流程，另分工業專管與水庫→淨水場→自來水兩條用途支路。標示這是一般教學路線，MBR等實廠配置可能不同。
steps.instructionEn: Draw treated used water to MF/UF, RO and UV. Add industrial dedicated supply and reservoir-to-waterworks-to-taps branches. Label this a general teaching route; actual configurations such as MBR may differ.
steps.observation: 確認原污水並未直接接入再生水產品端，間接飲用支路也沒有略過淨水場。
steps.observationEn: Confirm raw sewage is not connected directly to product and the indirect-potable branch does not omit waterworks.
steps.failure: 把NEWater等同未處理污水，或把間接飲用畫成直接供水。
steps.failureEn: Equating NEWater with untreated sewage or drawing indirect reuse as direct tap supply.
steps.check: 每個水質邊界都有名稱，兩條使用支路可獨立追蹤。
steps.checkEn: Name each water-quality boundary and make both use branches traceable.

knowledge.title: 水質邊界
knowledge.text: 已處理用水仍需後續純化；不同水流名稱代表不同處理狀態。
knowledge.textEn: Treated used water still requires further purification; stream names indicate different treatment states.

knowledge.title: 用途路徑
knowledge.text: 工業供水與間接飲用回用有不同的下游系統介面。
knowledge.textEn: Industrial supply and indirect potable reuse connect to different downstream systems.

options: 淨水場再處理後才供應自來水
直接跳過任何後續處理
改由工業專管自動變成家戶管線
optionsEn: Automatically turn an industrial main into household supply
quiz.question: 在PUB描述的間接飲用路徑中，水庫之後還有什麼？
quiz.questionEn: In PUB’s described indirect-potable route, what follows the reservoir?
quiz.explanation: 「間接」包含水庫混合與後續淨水處理，不能刪除。
quiz.explanationEn: Indirect reuse includes reservoir blending and subsequent waterworks treatment.

steps.title: 建立進流水的資料邊界
steps.titleEn: Define the feedwater data boundary
steps.objective: 把上游處理狀態與下游膜系統需求對齊。
steps.objectiveEn: Match upstream treatment status with downstream membrane evidence needs.
steps.instruction: 自設一張進流水紀錄表，分別列流量、混濁、溶解物及微生物資料欄。對缺少數據的欄位保留未知，說明它可能影響哪一道後續屏障。
steps.instructionEn: Create a feedwater-record template for flow, turbidity, dissolved substances and microbiological evidence. Keep missing fields unknown and identify the downstream barrier each may affect.
steps.observation: 比較水看起來透明與已取得化學或微生物證據的差別。
steps.observationEn: Distinguish visual clarity from chemical or microbiological evidence.
steps.failure: 以肉眼清澈取代進流水品質與處理狀態確認。
steps.failureEn: Substituting visual clarity for feed-quality and treatment-status verification.
steps.check: 至少四個資料欄各連到一項後續功能或驗證需求。
steps.checkEn: Link at least four fields to a downstream function or verification need.

knowledge.title: 污染物類別
knowledge.text: 粒子、溶解成分與微生物需要不同的量測與處理觀點。
knowledge.textEn: Particles, dissolved constituents and microorganisms require different measurement and treatment perspectives.

knowledge.title: 上游依賴
knowledge.text: 後段設備的表現受進流水條件影響，不能只看設備名稱。
knowledge.textEn: Downstream performance depends on feed conditions, not just equipment names.

options: 透明等於所有溶解物已去除
外觀已觀察，化學條件仍未知
可用出水流量代替化學資料
optionsEn: Clarity means all dissolved substances are removed
Product flow can replace chemical data
quiz.question: 進流水透明但化學資料缺漏，最適合的記錄是什麼？
quiz.questionEn: Feedwater looks clear but chemical data is missing. What should be recorded?
quiz.explanation: 外觀只能描述有限性質，不能補出未量測的污染物資料。
quiz.explanationEn: Appearance describes limited properties and cannot supply missing contaminant measurements.

steps.title: 分辨MF/UF與RO的任務
steps.titleEn: Distinguish MF/UF and RO roles
steps.objective: 用污染物類型理解不同膜屏障的互補。
steps.objectiveEn: Use contaminant classes to understand complementary membrane barriers.
steps.instruction: 畫三類符號代表粒子、微生物與溶解離子，將MF/UF與RO畫成不同功能方塊。用「可能被截留／仍需下段處理／需量測確認」標記，不填通用百分之百去除承諾。
steps.instructionEn: Represent particles, microorganisms and dissolved ions with symbols, and draw separate MF/UF and RO blocks. Label retained, requiring downstream treatment and needing measurement without universal 100-percent removal claims.
steps.observation: 注意前段粒子控制可改善後段條件，但不是所有溶解物的證明。
steps.observationEn: Particle control upstream can improve downstream conditions without proving removal of every dissolved constituent.
steps.failure: 把所有膜都當成同一種細篩，認為第一道即可取代全部後段。
steps.failureEn: Treating all membranes as the same fine sieve and assuming the first replaces every later barrier.
steps.check: 三類符號均有去向與未確認項，且MF/UF和RO功能可區分。
steps.checkEn: Give each symbol a destination and unresolved point, with distinguishable MF/UF and RO roles.

knowledge.title: 互補屏障
knowledge.text: 不同單元針對不同性質的污染物，串接可處理不同風險。
knowledge.textEn: Different units address different contaminant properties; a train combines complementary functions.

knowledge.title: 簡化限制
knowledge.text: 圖上符號只教分類，不代表特定膜在所有條件下的截留率。
knowledge.textEn: Diagram symbols teach categories, not rejection rates of a particular membrane under all conditions.

options: 所有溶解鹽類都已移除
該量測條件下粒子相關指標較低
optionsEn: All dissolved salts have been removed
RO and UV can always be omitted
A low particle-related indicator under those measurement conditions
quiz.question: MF/UF出水低濁度能單獨證明什麼？
quiz.questionEn: What does low MF/UF product turbidity establish on its own?
quiz.explanation: 低濁度不是所有化學與微生物條件的完整證明。
quiz.explanationEn: Low turbidity is not complete evidence of every chemical and microbiological condition.

steps.title: 檢查第一道膜屏障的完整性
steps.titleEn: Review first-barrier integrity evidence
steps.objective: 辨認產水量與膜屏障完整性不同。
steps.objectiveEn: Distinguish water production from membrane-barrier integrity.
steps.instruction: 自繪膜模組及密封介面，標出穿膜與繞過密封的兩種可能路徑。建立完整性證據、出水觀察與設備狀態三欄，所有數據留作自設教學示例。
steps.instructionEn: Sketch a membrane module and seals, marking passage through the membrane and possible seal bypass. Create integrity-evidence, product-observation and equipment-state columns using only labeled example data.
steps.observation: 觀察出水量正常是否仍可能有旁通或局部缺陷。
steps.observationEn: Consider whether normal product flow can coexist with bypass or a local defect.
steps.failure: 以流量正常或馬達運轉，替代屏障完整性證據。
steps.failureEn: Using normal flow or a running motor as proof of barrier integrity.
steps.check: 列出兩種缺陷假說及能區分它們的觀察，不能只寫「正常」。
steps.checkEn: List two defect hypotheses and observations distinguishing them rather than simply writing normal.

knowledge.title: 完整性與通量
knowledge.text: 流得過去說明有產水，不等於水只經過預期的屏障。
knowledge.textEn: Flow establishes production, not that all water passed through the intended barrier.

knowledge.title: 繞流介面
knowledge.text: 接合或密封也屬屏障的一部分，不能只檢查膜材料。
knowledge.textEn: Joints and seals are part of the barrier, not just the membrane material.

options: 產量有證據，屏障完整性尚未驗證
產量正常已足以證明完整性
可直接視為所有污染物都不存在
optionsEn: All contaminants can be considered absent
quiz.question: 流量正常但完整性證據不明，應如何分類？
quiz.questionEn: Flow is normal but integrity evidence is unclear. How should the result be classified?
quiz.explanation: 功能宣稱需要對應證據，產量不能替代完整性。
quiz.explanationEn: Functional claims need matching evidence; output quantity cannot substitute for integrity.
